forum definition catalogues and ForumMultilingualBehaviorTest: every seeded topic type, moderation reason/action/appeal state, reputation dimension, trust level, badge, confirmation state, animal community group, and platform taxonomy key resolves in EN, LT, and RU
CreateAnswer and ForumEventNotifier: notifications are materialized through Laravel Translator in the recipient's validated locale without mutating global request locale

add_knowledge_translation_provenance migration, KnowledgeTranslationSource, CreateKnowledgeGuideTranslation, KnowledgeGuideEditor, policy, and presenter: additive source/translator/type provenance, locked identity, authorized transactional creation, empty target prose, independent history/corrections, public-safe attribution, and no private-source disclosure

LocalizedTaxonName and AnimalTaxonomySelector: verified current-locale common name, verified fallback-locale common name, then exact scientific-name resolution with bounded eager-loaded queries and visible synonym context

ForumMultilingualBehaviorTest plus guide/auth regression: schema/indexes, catalogue resolution, category rows/cache clearing, recipient notification locale, guide provenance, original/private-content preservation, duplicate/invalid locale denial, connected Livewire creation, translate-action availability, scientific-name invariance, and selector fallback passed

dependency-free headless Chrome runner: English desktop/mobile/320px forum, Livewire profile locale update, Lithuanian desktop/mobile translation-source editor, Russian forum, locale restoration, one H1/main, no overflow, unnamed controls, raw keys, invalid tables/images, or console errors
